<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template for the amide coupling step (carboxylic acid + amine → amide). We'll search the template catalog for a template that breaks a carboxylic acid and forms an amide.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic acid"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
